cases.title: Comp 1: a child with no keys rides a null moved by expressions; the answer names the parent, its expressions, and puts steps on the parent

checks.detail: no step on Shake Control (steps are on Shake Control, (none))

rubric.reason: The answer runs from source to bullets, then 4 steps, then one closing question naming only *Set the pivot*, which is step 3's tag ("Try them, or want to go deeper on step 3 with *Set the pivot*?"); it has no greeting or recap and is 141 words.
It opens with "rock.png rides on Shake Control, a null moved by expressions", names the Position and Rotation expressions, and every step is on layer Shake Control rather than the child.

"settling over about 1 s" is stated as plain fact for both Position and Rotation, but no tool returned it; it is inferred from the decay values in the expression text (decays[1]=4, decay=3) and is not marked as an inference.

There are four steps, each starting with an action (Open, Open, Select/drag, Play it back) on Shake Control or the comp, ordered by measured effect (Position 12.15 px before Rotation 9.36 px), and step 3 says the pivot's current spot was not read.

Steps 1 and 2 each ask the learner to open an expression, state what the read text shows ("uses the second hit's size and settle for all three", "0.75° at most"), end with "Not something I teach yet.", and give no new values or code.
